text: clear; sed -i 's/^#\? *play-and-exit=.*/play-and-exit=0/' ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc 2>/dev/null; grep -q '^play-and-exit=0' ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p ~/.config/vlc; echo 'play-and-exit=0' >> ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc; }; echo "STATUS=$(grep -c '^play-and-exit=0' ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc)"
memo: Ran clear+force-fix+verify in terminal e11. Next: crop e11 and read the line 'STATUS=N' at top of the cleared terminal. STATUS=1 (or more) means play-and-exit=0 is set -> done. STATUS=0 or error -> re-run fix.
